about: The adventure's heroes: ROUNDS's own two players. Each is a VS custom character (VS's workshop character system) whose look in a run is drawn by the hidden ROUNDS; its VS sprite is the portrait ROUNDS renders of it (Portraits) and only shows if ROUNDS is not running. seat = ROUNDS player id (its colour).

columns.seat: ROUNDS player / link seat (0 Orange, 1 Blue)
columns.color: RRGGBB of the ROUNDS team colour (stand-in sprite until ROUNDS's portrait exists)
columns.basePrefab: VS CharacterType whose character prefab the custom character is built from
columns.folder: workshop folder name hashed into its runtime CharacterType
columns.walkFrames: VS walking frames (the ROUNDS picture replaces them in a run)
columns.maxHp: VS max health (ROUNDS's health is the real one; VS shows it)
columns.moveSpeed: VS move speed multiplier (ROUNDS movement cards scale it)
columns.growth: VS experience multiplier (more level-ups = more ROUNDS cards early)

rows.description: ROUNDS's orange player with ROUNDS's gun. Every level-up is a ROUNDS card pick.
ROUNDS's blue player with ROUNDS's gun. Every level-up is a ROUNDS card pick.
